coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .gitignore due to HTTP 400 API errors, resulting in an incomplete audit.
learnings: Implement automatic retries or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) to prevent incomplete file reviews from forcing an 'inconclusive' package verdict.
